chosen.title: young boy scoring free kick goal
chosen.why: Kids in kit on an outdoor pitch, natural daylight; a boy in black runs in and his foot contacts the ball at exactly 1.0s, ball is airborne toward the wall/goal by 1.1s, so 1.0-1.7s reads instantly as 'kid kicks ball'. 16:9, no logos or watermarks, wide framing. Only 720p available (no 1080p).

alternates.why: Low wide-angle shot: oversized ball in foreground, kid goalkeeper in the yellow-wall goal, a (adult) foot enters and strikes the ball at ~3.4s. Very graphic kick moment but the kicker is an adult and the wide-angle/yellow wall looks more stylized; 720p only.

Kids' team in blue kit warming up in a line with a ball in the foreground; strong 'kids soccer' atmosphere and clean natural light but no kick action, so only a fallback if the kick beat is dropped. 720p only.

notes: Mixkit's kids-soccer inventory is small (4 unique kid clips across 6 queries: 6652, 34230, 35981, 13727, 35934). 13727 (boy holding deflated ball watching through a fence) and 35934 (aerial pitch) have no kick and were not shortlisted. None of the candidates had a 1080p rendition; all are 1280x720. 6652 has a second kick later in the clip (~3.0-3.5s a second boy shoots) if another take is needed.
